transcript.en: Greek Island Holidays, can I help you?
transcript.zh: 希腊岛度假村，有什么可以帮到您？

transcript.en: Yes, I hope so! I have a friend who’s just come back from Corfu and she’s recommended some apartments in Arillas. She thought they might be on your list.
transcript.zh: 是的，希望能帮上！我有一个朋友刚从科孚岛回来，她推荐了一些阿里拉斯的公寓。她认为你们有。

transcript.en: Arillas..... umm let me check. Can you give me the names?
transcript.zh: 阿里拉斯......嗯，让我检查一下。可以给我具体名称吗？

transcript.en: Yes, the first is Rose Garden Apartments. Could you tell me a little bit of information about the apartments, its features and prices, for instance?
transcript.zh: 可以，第一个是玫瑰园公寓。你能告诉我一些公寓信息吗，比如特点和价格？

transcript.en: Well, at Rose Garden they have a huge parking lot and it is free parking. So, it can be very convenient for some big families who drive there to spend holidays.
transcript.zh: 玫瑰园公寓有一个很大的停车场，而且是免费停车。所以，对于一些开车去那里度假的大家庭来说，还是很方便的。

transcript.en: Oh, that’s great. Our whole family will be going.
transcript.zh: 那太好了。我们全家都会去。

transcript.en: And there’s a big swimming pool inside which can accommodate over 50 people. We are thinking of replacing it into an aquarium, but it’s still in discussion.
transcript.zh: 里面有一个可以容纳50多人的大游泳池。我们正在考虑将其替换为水族馆，但仍在讨论中。

transcript.en: That sounds exciting. What about the cost?
transcript.zh: 听起来很令人兴奋。费用呢？

transcript.en: 219 dollars.
That seems reasonable. I’m just jotting down some notes. Now the second one my friend mentioned was called Blue Bay.
transcript.zh: 看起来挺合理的。我记下来。我朋友提到的第二个叫蓝湾。

transcript.en: Blue Bay? Oh yes, in fact that’s very popular and it has some special features.
transcript.zh: 蓝湾？哦，是的，它很受欢迎，而且它有一些特色。

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: The main attraction is the large man-made lake, and it’s only around a kilometer from some shops.
transcript.zh: 主要的景点是大型人造湖，距离一些商店只有一公里左右。

transcript.en: Is it much more expensive than the first one?
transcript.zh: 比第一个贵很多吗？

transcript.en: Actually it’s 50 dollars cheaper than the first one. That’s mainly because they don’t have a parking lot there.
transcript.zh: 其实比第一个便宜50美元。这主要是因为他们那里没有停车场。

transcript.en: Moreover, we plan to install a lift, but we are currently short of funds, so we don’t have it at the moment and this apartment isn’t really suitable for those with disabilities.
transcript.zh: 另外，我们打算加装电梯，但目前资金短缺，所以暂时还装不了，所以这个公寓不适合残障人士。

transcript.en: Right. Now there are just two more apartments on the list. The third one is Sunshade Apartments.
transcript.zh: 好。现在名单上只有两套公寓了。第三个是遮阳公寓。

transcript.en: This one is on top of a hill with a huge parking lot.
transcript.zh: 这个在山顶上，有一个巨大的停车场。

transcript.en: Each room used to have a nice kitchen but we have turned it into a beautiful garden since our customers don’t cook much, and they have shared barbecue facilities.
transcript.zh: 每个房间以前都有一个不错的厨房，但我们把它改成了一个美丽的花园，因为我们的客人都不怎么做饭，花园里有共用烧烤设施。

transcript.en: Sounds great.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: Yes, it is well-equipped.
transcript.zh: 是的，装备精良。

transcript.en: How much does it cost?
transcript.zh: 多少钱？

transcript.en: 490 dollars.
I don’t think that would be within our budget, unfortunately. And the last one sounds a bit expensive too - the Grand Apartments!
transcript.zh: 不幸的是，我认为这不在我们的预算之内。最后一个听起来也有点贵——大公寓！

transcript.en: That one is quite reasonable. There’s no parking lot, but parking on the street requires no charge.
transcript.zh: 这个价格还好。没有停车场，但是路边停车不收费。

transcript.en: Many teenagers and businessmen have come here to spend their summer holiday. But children make the biggest part of our customers, there is a huge painting room for them.
transcript.zh: 许多青少年和商人来这里度过他们的暑假。但是我们顾客中最多的是孩子，有一个巨大的画室供他们使用。

transcript.en: Sounds lovely, OK, I will think about which one to book with my family.
transcript.zh: 听起来很不错，好的，我会和家人一起考虑预订哪一个。

transcript.en: That’s fine. We’ve got plenty of apartments here when you come. Is there anything else you need to know about accommodation?
transcript.zh: 好的。您来时我们有足够公寓可供选择。关于住宿还有什么需要了解的吗？

transcript.en: Oh actually, could you tell me some more details about Arillas in general?
transcript.zh: 哦，实际上，你能告诉我更多关于阿里拉斯的详情吗？

transcript.en: Sure. What would you like to know?
transcript.zh: 当然。您想了解什么？

transcript.en: Well, my friend told me that Arillas was pretty, but I don’t know what the best way is to see the town.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我的朋友告诉我阿里拉斯很漂亮，但我不知道游览这个小镇的最好方式。

transcript.en: Well, if you want to enjoy the scenery, then the blue city bus is recommended. Just a second while I check…
transcript.zh: 嗯，如果您想看风景，推荐蓝城巴士。稍等，我来看看……

transcript.en: Ah, that one is a business route mainly for commuters. The green one is a double-decker which offers a nicer view.
transcript.zh: 啊，那是一条以通勤者为主的商务路线。绿色的是双层巴士，视野更好。

transcript.en: I also heard that the ferry boat trip is quite popular.
transcript.zh: 我还听说渡船游览很受欢迎。

transcript.en: Yes, if you want to immerse yourself in the magnificent sea views, then the ferry boat trip is a must.
transcript.zh: 是的，如果你想沉浸在壮丽的海景中，那么渡船之旅是必须的。

transcript.en: The trip used to last 35 minutes but we made it a little bit longer to 50-minutes in response to our customers’ demands. A 30-minute seafood dinner is included in this trip.
transcript.zh: 渡船之旅过去持续 35 分钟，但为了响应客户的需求，我们将其延长到 50 分钟。此行程包含30分钟海鲜大餐。

transcript.en: Ok. And one more question, I like riding bikes. Can I rent a bike and cycle around the town?
transcript.zh: 好的。还有一个问题，我喜欢骑自行车。我可以租一辆自行车在城里骑车吗？

transcript.en: Of course. There is a mall on Main street and Arillas Bike Hire is located behind it.
transcript.zh: 当然可以。主街上有一个商场，后面就是阿里拉斯自行车租赁处。

transcript.en: Ok, I have made a note of that.
transcript.zh: 好的，我已经记下了。

transcript.en: Furthermore, I’d like to suggest three famous museums, from which you can learn native history and culture.
transcript.zh: 另外，我想推荐三个有名的博物馆，你可以从中了解当地的历史和文化。

transcript.en: That sounds fun.
transcript.zh: 听起来很有趣。

transcript.en: Ok. The first one has an exhibition of the interior design as well as some famous paintings and sculptures. Some of the paintings are donated by some well-known scientists.
transcript.zh: 好的。第一个有室内设计展览以及一些著名的绘画和雕塑。部分画作由知名科学家捐赠。

transcript.en: That’s great.
transcript.zh: 太好了。

transcript.en: Yeah. The second one is about something that is familiar to us, but actually most people don’t know much about it, which is fizzy drinks or soda.
transcript.zh: 是的。第二个是我们熟悉的东西，其实大部分人都不太了解，就是汽水或者苏打水。

transcript.en: The visitors will be shown the history of some famous products in this industry and how they are produced.
transcript.zh: 参观者将了解该行业一些著名产品的历史以及它们是如何生产的。

transcript.en: It’s interesting to know that some products have been taken to the space before.
transcript.zh: 有趣的是，有些产品之前被带到了太空。

transcript.en: Wow, I would like to go there.
transcript.zh: 哇，我想去那儿看看。

transcript.en: Yes, you should and the last one is about some special phenomena outside the planet where we live.
transcript.zh: 是的，应该去看看，最后一个是关于我们居住的星球之外的一些特殊现象。

transcript.en: Some experts are there to unveil the mystery if the visitors have any questions, various machines and equipment are displayed inside. You can’t miss it. Are there any more questions for now?
transcript.zh: 如果参观者有任何疑问，一些专家会在那里揭开谜团。里面陈列着各种机器和设备。不容错过。现在您还有什么问题吗？

transcript.en: No, that is all.
transcript.zh: 没有了。

transcript.en: I hope you have a happy journey.
transcript.zh: 祝您旅途愉快。

transcript.en: Thank you.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。
